mevModuleSetSniperFee((address,address,u.notice: Lets the bound MEV module signal an "extra" fee on top of the         pool's base LP fee for the in-progress swap. The hook collects         the extra from the swap's input currency in `_beforeSwap` and         lazily flushes it to `sniperFeeRecipient[pid]` on the next         swap. The pool's LP fee is NOT changed by this call — the         locker reward split still receives only the base pool fee.

pairedFee(bytes32).notice: Fee charged when selling ArtCoins for paired token.

Once true, the         extension can no longer be swapped — credibility lever for         projects that want to commit to a specific renderer-data shape.

poolExtensionSetup(bytes32).notice: Whether the pool extension's post-locker setup has completed.

protocolFee().notice: Currently configured hook-level protocol fee, in fee-denominator         units. Always 0 in artcoins v1 (since `protocolFeeNumerator = 0`).

protocolFeeNumerator().notice: Hook-level protocol fee numerator. Disabled by default in         artcoins v1: the protocol's share comes from the locker reward         array (factory-injected protocol reward slot), NOT from a         separate hook skim on top of the pool fee. Setting this to         non-zero would make the trader pay strictly more than the         configured pool fee. Reserved for future hook variants.

setPoolExtension((address,address,uint24.notice: Replaces the pool's extension contract with another allowlisted         one, re-running the extension's init callbacks so it can wire         up its own state. Token admin only; allowlist-gated; reverts         when the slot is locked via `lockPoolExtension`.

setProtocolFeeNumerator(uint256).notice: Updates the protocol fee numerator (capped at `MAX_PROTOCOL_FEE_NUMERATOR`). Factory owner only.
